summary: No usable aerial (the only 'aerial' is an airliner-window shot where the stadium is a speck). Day: upper-deck corner view with the downtown skyline; night: wide upper-level panorama under the lights.

files.note: Elevated upper-deck corner view of the current stadium (opened 2014), empty; field fills the lower-right, roughly rows 1000-1793, skyline and stands above. A few people stand on the stairs in the lower-left.

closest_misses.why: 2024 photo taken from an airliner window; the stadium is a tiny spot in the frame (the cropped version is 965 px and still far away).
Good 2016 elevated end-zone view with skyline, but exactly 1600 px and the field sits lower; kept as the alternate day photo.
